text:
zoe: Build alert: prod linkcheck failed for /guides/ops#rolling-updates. Link reported missing fragment but heading present in MD. Anyone seen invisible chars or odd hyphenization?

omar: Possibility: soft-hyphen or ZWNBSP from copy-paste. Quick check: open the file in a hex-capable editor or run `cat -v` to reveal.

priya: Repro steps I used:
`cat -v docs/guides/ops.md | sed -n '1,200p'`
I found a U+00AD after "rolling-" which caused legacy slug to collapse the hyphen. Docusaurus slugger kept the visible hyphen, so the fragment differs.

zoe: Thanks. Proposed fix: strip U+00AD/U+200C/U+200B in a migration pass, and regenerate redirect mappings for migrated anchors. Also add a small CI check that compares outputs from our legacy slugify vs Docusaurus slugger for all headings touched by a PR.

omar: +1. I'll add a tiny script to normalize headings and a test that injects a soft-hyphen to assert parity.

priya: I'll follow up with a short PR and include a note to QA to run linkcheck across the mkdocs-migrated pages.

docs-bot: New PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5530 by priya — heading normalization + slug-compare CI
